stem: A 1-month-old infant weighing 5 kg requires maintenance intravenous fluids and has normal electrolytes. Which prescription is most appropriate?

options.text: 0.9% sodium chloride with 10% glucose at 20 mL/hour
0.9% sodium chloride with 5% glucose at 20 mL/hour
0.45% sodium chloride with 5% glucose at 20 mL/hour

explanation: Young infants commonly require isotonic sodium chloride with 10% glucose for maintenance because of glucose needs. A 5 kg infant needs about 100 mL/kg/day, or roughly 20 mL/hour.
